message:
So the power went out last night, and you know what that means—family group chat to the rescue! 💬✨ It's amazing how quickly we can share tips and tricks to keep things running smoothly during a blackout. I found a fantastic resource that covers everything from safety tips to fun activities to keep everyone entertained while we wait for the lights to come back on. 

Remember, a little preparation can go a long way to make those unexpected moments more manageable. What’s your go-to tip for surviving a blackout with the family?
